facts.f01: Ampwright Labs showed solid-state battery cells for phones on Thursday
facts.f02: Ampwright says the cells store 1,050 Wh per liter
facts.f03: The company claims the cells charge to 80% in 12 minutes
facts.f04: A cell kept 90% of its capacity after 1,200 cycles in Ampwright's tests
facts.f05: Ampwright plans to begin mass production in 2028
facts.f06: Ampwright announced $310 million in new funding
facts.f07: The round values Ampwright at $2.1 billion
facts.f08: Ampwright will open a pilot production line in 2027

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Ampwright Labs showed off solid-state battery cells built for phones on Thursday.
Ampwright says the cells store 1,050 Wh per liter.
The company also claims the cells charge to 80% in 12 minutes.
In Ampwright's own tests, a cell kept 90% of its capacity after 1,200 charge cycles.

byteward.sentence: Ampwright Labs on Thursday showed solid-state battery cells designed for smartphones.
The company says they store 1,050 Wh per liter.
Ampwright plans to begin mass production in 2028.

launch-desk.sentence: Ampwright Labs has shown solid-state battery cells for phones.
The startup also announced $310 million in new funding.
The round values it at $2.1 billion.
Ampwright will open a pilot production line in 2027.
